For Airport Sponsors

A GIS & compliance-mapping menu built for small and regional airports.

TDH's existing GIS, grant administration, and land-use disciplines packaged specifically for general-aviation, reliever, and small commercial-service airports navigating FAA planning and grant-assurance mapping requirements.

01 — PLANNING

Airport Layout Plan (ALP) Digitization & Updates

Convert legacy paper or CAD-based ALPs into a maintained GIS layer set aligned to current FAA Advisory Circular standards.

02 — SAFETY / COMPLIANCE

FAR Part 77 / OEI Obstruction Surface Mapping

Model imaginary and one-engine-inoperative (OEI) surfaces and flag penetrations for safety review and grant compliance.

03 — SUBMITTAL SUPPORT

Airports GIS (AGIS) Submittal Support

Prepare survey and mapping deliverables to FAA Airports GIS (AGIS) program specifications for eALP submission.

04 — ASSET MANAGEMENT

Pavement, Apron & Hangar Inventory Mapping

Geo-reference pavement condition, tie-downs, hangars, and leaseholds into a single asset-management-ready layer.

05 — GRANTS

NPIAS / ACIP Grant Compliance Mapping

Tie capital improvement project (ACIP) mapping to NPIAS eligibility and grant-assurance reporting requirements.

06 — ENVIRONMENTAL

Wildlife Hazard & Safety-Area Buffer Mapping

Map runway safety area (RSA), runway object-free area (ROFA), and runway protection zone (RPZ) buffers alongside wildlife-attractant sites.

Certified SB / DBE / ACDBE — procurement-ready for airport sponsor and public-agency contracts.
